ingredients.name_en: Neem leaf paste or neem seed pulp
ingredients.name_hi: नीम की पत्तियों का पेस्ट या नीम बीज का गूदा

steps_en: Mix all the ingredients in a large drum and stir clockwise with a long stick.
Cover the drum with a gunny bag and keep it in the shade for 48 hours to ferment, stirring clockwise every morning and evening.
After 48 hours, filter through a muslin cloth.
Spray it as it is on the crop, without dilution, 200 litres per acre. It keeps for up to 6 months.
steps_hi: सभी सामग्री को बड़े ड्रम में मिलाकर लंबी लकड़ी से घड़ी की दिशा में चलाएँ।
ड्रम को बोरी से ढककर 48 घंटे छाँव में खमीर उठने दें; सुबह-शाम घड़ी की दिशा में चलाएँ।
48 घंटे बाद मलमल के कपड़े से छान लें।
इसे बिना पानी मिलाए फसल पर छिड़कें, प्रति एकड़ 200 लीटर। यह 6 महीने तक रखा जा सकता है।

ingredients.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
ingredients.quote: Water: 200 litres, Cow Dung: 2 kg, Cow Urine: 10 litres, Neem Leaves Paste or Seed Pulp: 10 kg.
ingredients.note: NITI toolkit (a government guide to natural farming); not yet tested in Malwa.

per_area_sqm.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
per_area_sqm.quote: Control of sucking pests: Spray 200 litres of Neemastra per acre

steps_en.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
steps_en.quote: Mix all the ingredients together in a large drum. Stir the mixture clockwise with a long stick. Cover the drum with a gunny bag and keep it in the shade for 48 hours to ferment. Stir the solution every morning and evening in a clockwise direction. After 48 hours, filter the solution through a muslin cloth.
steps_en.note: NITI toolkit (a government guide to natural farming); not yet tested in Malwa.

ferment_days.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
ferment_days.quote: keep it in the shade for 48 hours to ferment

shelf_life_days.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
shelf_life_days.quote: This formulation can be stored for up to 6 months.

apply_method.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
apply_method.quote: Apply the prepared solution directly to the crops as a foliar spray without needing any further dilution.

source_notes: AI research (2026-10-07). Controls sucking pests (jassids, aphids, whiteflies) and small caterpillars. Safety notes not sourced yet (TODO(agronomist)).
